notes.title: Public Testing Era Begins 🔥
notes.content:
Right now I uploaded the Alpha version to the public testing branch in demo. This is the latest version of development and is very buggy. If you want to take a look, I will be glad, as well as your ⁠bug reports 🐞 for our [url=https://discord.com/invite/atDdg7EFQN]discord server[/url].
[h3]There's so much missing features or empty info, for example, there's only 1 NPC, on close interaction it says "Grab" but I didn't implement it yet... So it does nothing. And also Astral is also just for preview, Astralons do not work 🥴[/h3]
To install Test Public branch, go to SkyCraft Demo -> Properties -> Betas and select test_public 😤
